title: Boralo Mod By Krali10
description: A massive expansion mod adding new dimensions, powerful abilities like flight and lightning, custom tools, and unique ores!
body:
Boralo Mod 1: Unleash the Chaos

Boralo Mod 1 is a feature-rich expansion that introduces a massive array of new mechanics, mystical dimensions, and powerful tools designed to redefine your survival experience.

🌟 Key Features:

    Abilities: Harness unique powers like Lightning, Flight, and devastating Ultimate abilities.

    Tools & Weapons: Take down enemies with specialized weapons such as the Chainsaw (Testere) or the Staff.

    Utility: Use the Toprak Converter to manipulate the terrain and build faster.

    Exploration: Explore custom-coded biomes and dimensions featuring unique ores like Bash Ore and decorative blocks like Apalachia.

Technical Details:

    Mod Loader: Forge

    Created with: MCreator
